theater_main_quest_01_04_05_001:
You've been working hard in the Dungeon,
haven't you?
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_003:
Reaching the 10th floor so quickly...
That's amazing.
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_004:
N-n-no, not at all!
It's really nothing...!
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_005:
I need to get way stronger, but I'm nowhere near it.
My fighting is basically an amateur's...
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_006:
A-and I'm not even close to my goal...
I'm just hopeless... Um, uh, er...
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_007: ...Is there no one to teach you how to fight?
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_014:
Just Ais is fine.
That's what everyone calls me.
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_016: N-no, I don't mind at all!
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_017:
S-so, um, about the training...
What should I do?
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_020:
I've been thinking since yesterday about what
we should do, but...
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_025:
The way you just reacted—
feel all kinds of things like that as we fight.
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_026:
Do that, and you'll learn how to fight
whether you like it or not.
theater_main_quest_01_04_05_028:
Being cowardly to protect yourself is important.
But you're also afraid of "something" else.
theater_main_quest_01_04_06_001:
Don't get reckless.
Don't leave blind spots.
theater_main_quest_01_04_06_005: You're a little short on those.
theater_main_quest_01_04_06_012:
...Not enough...
This won't fulfill my lady's command... Hm?
theater_main_quest_01_04_06_014:
Hmph. You seem to have a little backbone.
Now then...
theater_main_quest_01_04_06_018: Show me you can master it.
theater_main_quest_01_04_07_001: Mr. Bell, how far shall we go today?
theater_main_quest_01_04_07_002:
Oh, right.
Since we're taking tomorrow off, I'd like
to dive as deep as we can.
theater_main_quest_01_04_07_004:
Can't be helped. It's for your lodging, right?
Besides, I've got stuff to do too...
theater_main_quest_01_04_07_005:
Mr. Bell... Why are you already beaten up
before we even enter the Dungeon lately?
theater_main_quest_01_04_08_001: (Wide field of view, no blind spots...!)
theater_main_quest_01_04_08_004: There's kind of a lot of them...
theater_main_quest_01_04_08_005: Should we retreat for now and regroup?
theater_main_quest_01_04_08_007:
(If I flinch at something like this,
I'll never catch up to her!)
theater_main_quest_01_04_08_008: (I want to catch up! No matter what!)
theater_main_quest_01_04_09_003: How are you getting stronger so fast?
theater_main_quest_01_04_09_004:
Whaaat?!
I-I'm not strong or anything...
theater_main_quest_01_04_09_006:
It's just, um... There's someone I really want
to catch up to... and a place I have to reach,
no matter what. I think that's why.
theater_main_quest_01_04_09_007:
I see...
I understand. I'm the same.
theater_main_quest_01_04_09_011:
In the Dungeon, you have to be able
to sleep anytime, anywhere.
theater_main_quest_01_04_09_012: Um... are you maybe just sleepy?
theater_main_quest_01_04_09_018:
That was fast!
I-is this the skill of a first-tier adventurer...?!
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_005: You looked hungry, so let's eat something.
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_009:
Don't worry about it.
I'm hungry too.
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_010: Two red bean cream Jyaga Maru-kun, please.
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_013: Extra cream, and pile on the red beans.
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_017:
Whaaaat do you think
you're DOOOOOOOOOOOOING?!
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_019:
Honestly, it's one after another with youuu!
And now, finally, of ALL people—
THIS woman?!
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_020:
WAAAAAH! I'm s-s-s-sorry!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm SORRY!
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_021: ...So you're saying it's just two more days?
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_022:
Y-yes! The deal was only until
the Loki Familia's expedition starts.
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_024:
...Sigh.
Fine. If you feel that strongly...
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_027:
Try anything funny with my Bell,
and this deal is off on the spot! Got it?!
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_029: And seducing him is absolutely out of the question!
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_031:
Don't think you can stake a claim on my Bell!
I got here first, after all!
theater_main_quest_01_04_10_034:
Mmmgh!
Hey, you two! Break it uuup!!
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_004: ...You countered me for the first time.
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_006: Today's the last day, isn't it?
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_007: Thank you so much for this past week...!
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_010: Yes! You too, Ais... um, good luck...!
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_012: I don't know if I can catch up, but I have to try.
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_013: I'll keep chasing her, until I can reach her.
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_014:
So your training with Wallen-whatsit
really ended this morning?
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_015:
Yes... As planned, the Loki Familia's
expedition starts today, apparently.
theater_main_quest_01_04_11_020: Sorry, I'll look when I get back!
theater_main_quest_01_04_12_003:
Lili, don't you feel something?
Like someone's watching us...
theater_main_quest_01_04_12_004:
Hmm...
But something about this floor does feel off.
theater_main_quest_01_04_12_005:
Yeah. There are way too few monsters.
And adventurers, too...
theater_main_quest_01_04_12_006: (It was just like this that day...)
theater_main_quest_01_04_13_003: Why is there a Minotaur on the 9th floor...?
theater_main_quest_01_04_13_004:
Mr. Bell, let's run!
We can't stand up to it right now!
Hurry...!
theater_main_quest_01_04_14_004:
(At this rate... it'll get me eventually.
I have to find an opening and run...!)
theater_main_quest_01_04_14_015:
(Good, that's it!
Now I can run too—)
theater_main_quest_01_04_15_009:
You did well.
I'll save you now.
theater_main_quest_01_04_15_011:
(Save me? Be saved? By her, again?
The same way? All over again?)
theater_main_quest_01_04_15_014:
(If I don't reach for the heights now,
then when will I ever get there?!)
theater_main_quest_01_04_15_016: What the hell are you doing...?
theater_main_quest_01_04_15_019:
I can't let Ais Wallenstein
save me again...
theater_main_quest_01_04_15_021:
Today, for the first time,
I'm going on an adventure.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_001:
Well, stealing someone's prey in the Dungeon
is against the rules.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_002:
Huh...? Wait, ain't that the tomato kid
from before?
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_003:
Pfft, hahaha! What's with that guy?!
He's got a real thing for Minotaurs!
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_004: No wonder he doesn't wanna be saved.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_005:
Not by the same chick who saw him
look so pathetic in the exact same spot!
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_006:
Are you sure? Isn't that kid Level 1?
He's totally gonna get killed!
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_007:
Leave him be, Tiona.
That brat's being a "man" right now.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_008:
If I got saved again,
I'd wanna die.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_009:
Please... Mr. Adventurer,
please save Mr. Bell...
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_012: Little Prum, you shouldn't be moving yet.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_013:
Lili will do anything!
Anything at all...!
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_019:
Don't get the wrong idea.
I ain't saving some weakling.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_020:
But I'd hate even more to sink to the level
of trash that picks on weaker guys.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_023:
A month ago, that boy looked like
nothing but a greenhorn to Bete...
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_030: The tale of a boy who yearned to be a hero.
theater_main_quest_01_04_16_031: I loved that fairy tale too...
theater_main_quest_01_04_17_006: He's passed out on his feet...
theater_main_quest_01_04_17_011:
In that state, he's practically
begging you to look!
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_001:
...Level 2, huh.
I really beat that Minotaur...
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_003:
...Huh?
That's it? I ranked up just now...?
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_005:
"Wh-whoa, I can feel the power
surging through me...!"
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_006: Did you think it'd be like that?
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_008:
Well, you'll feel it soon enough!
More importantly, I have good news...
Wanna hear it?
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_010:
Your second one— No, wait!
Um, you know, that thing! The skill you've been
waiting for finally appeared!
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_013:
Whoaaa! A skill!
I have a skill! I did it, Goddess, I did it!
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_014:
Heh heh.
Argonaut—a "hero's wish," huh... Heh heh.
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_015:
Bell, still dreaming of fairy-tale heroes
at your age, are we?
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_016:
Wha?! N-no, I mean,
it's not like that!
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_019:
I'm heading out now, so
cheer up before I get back, 'kay?
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_021:
Today's the gods' meeting that happens
once every three months... Denatus!
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_023:
That's right, Bell! That's where they decide

theater_main_quest_01_05_01_026:
Maybe I'll get new armor

theater_main_quest_01_05_01_027: I wonder what cool name I'll get!
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_028:
Like Fire Blizzard...
or Tornado Typhoon...!
theater_main_quest_01_05_01_031:
This armor was really good.
Light and easy to move in.
theater_main_quest_01_05_02_005:
"Little Rookie"?
That's your title, Mr. Bell?
theater_main_quest_01_05_02_006:
Yeah...
What do you think, Lili?
theater_main_quest_01_05_02_008:
Right?!
The goddess says inoffensive is good, but...!
theater_main_quest_01_05_02_010:
Congratulations on your Level Up,
Mr. Cranel.
theater_main_quest_01_05_02_011:
Drink as much as you like today!
It's your celebration, Bell!
theater_main_quest_01_05_02_013: The guy who hit Level 2 the fastest ever...
theater_main_quest_01_05_02_015:
Yes. It comes with the territory when

theater_main_quest_01_05_02_016:
Just think of it as being popular.

theater_main_quest_01_05_02_019:
Mama Mia says she's lending us to you,

theater_main_quest_01_05_02_021:
Ahaha...
Well then, don't mind if I do!
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_001:
...Not this... Not this one either.
I guess they don't sell his armor anymore...
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_002:
I'm telling you!
Why is it always shoved off in that corner...?!
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_003:
I'm putting my life on the line here!
You could treat me a little better!
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_005:
Oh, yes!
Do you not sell Welf Crozzo's armor anymore?
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_009:
Pfft, hahahahaha, heh heh heh heh!
We've got it, adventurer!
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_010: If it's Welf Crozzo's armor you want!
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_011:
Never thought the famous "Little Rookie"

theater_main_quest_01_05_03_012:
I never thought I'd meet
Mr. Crozzo himself, either.
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_013:
Hey... Could you not call me "Crozzo"?
I hate being called that.
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_015:
"Mister," huh... Well, that'll do for now.
Hey, Bell Cranel!
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_016:
You came to buy my work TWICE!
That makes you my customer! Am I right?
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_021:
Ah, sorry. Just a little turf war.
Anyway, Bell.
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_022: ...How about signing a direct contract with me?
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_024:
I'll be your personal smith and make
whatever weapons or armor you need.
But...
theater_main_quest_01_05_03_025:
I'd appreciate it if you'd hear out
one selfish request. I'll make it worth it!
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_002:
Sorry, Bell. Asking something this crazy
the day after we met.
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_003:
Oh, no. If it's so you can get the Blacksmith
ability, Mr. Welf, it concerns me too,
since we have a contract.
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_004:
Sure, it's great for HIM... But then why not
explore with people from his own Familia?
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_006:
Ah... W-well, see, Lili.
In his Familia, Mr. Welf is kind of—
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_007:
An outcast, right? You got all soft over
his sob story, and then he bribed you
with new armor!
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_008: Why didn't you say a single word to Lili first?
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_010: Am I that much of a nuisance, shorty?
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_011:
Lili is not a shorty!
Lili has a name: Liliruca Arde!
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_012:
Got it!
Nice to meet ya, Li'l E.
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_014:
But hey, Lili.
I really like it!
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_015:
The armor Mr. Welf Crozzo makes.
So—
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_019:
The cursed magic-sword smiths?!
The fallen noble family of smiths?!
theater_main_quest_01_05_04_022:
A family of smiths who made their name forging

theater_main_quest_01_05_04_023:
But... one day, they lost that power entirely,

theater_main_quest_01_05_04_024:
Yeah, it's just the name of some washed-up

theater_main_quest_01_05_05_003:
Crap, it's an Infant Dragon!
Run for it!
theater_main_quest_01_05_05_012:
No doubt about it, that's your Argonaut skill.
The potential to overturn any crisis...
theater_main_quest_01_05_05_013:
A ticket for a kid who's foolishly obsessed

theater_main_quest_01_05_05_014:
Against the overwhelming absurdity of power,
you fight back with one tiny power of your own.
theater_main_quest_01_05_05_015:
In other words, a "hero's strike."
Perfect for someone who dreams of heroes, huh?
theater_main_quest_01_05_05_017:
Oh, by the way, Goddess. Have you ever heard

theater_main_quest_01_05_05_018: That's your smith's family name, right?
theater_main_quest_01_05_05_019:
I know they were "the family that made

theater_main_quest_01_05_05_021:
But I did ask around at the shop

Apparently he can forge magic swords.
theater_main_quest_01_05_05_023:
Really powerful ones, they say...
In his Familia, they grumble that he's
wasting his talent.
theater_main_quest_01_05_05_024:
He's definitely got skill, but there's
some story there, I bet.
That smith you made a contract with.
theater_main_quest_01_05_06_001: Huh, Li'l E's taking the day off?
theater_main_quest_01_05_06_002:
Yeah. The gnome who runs her lodging is sick,

So sorry, but today...
theater_main_quest_01_05_06_003:
Ah, got it.

theater_main_quest_01_05_06_005:
I promised, didn't I?
I'd pay you back for letting me join your party.
theater_main_quest_01_05_06_006: I'll make you a whole new set of gear.

theater_main_quest_01_05_06_009:

Some gear you wanna try out?

That's true... Oh,

theater_main_quest_01_05_06_023:

theater_main_quest_01_05_06_024:

I was kinda testing you there.

Is that a drop item?

theater_main_quest_01_05_06_030: I'll use that horn as material for your gear.

theater_main_quest_01_05_07_004:
All of 'em knew I was a Crozzo and wanted

theater_main_quest_01_05_07_005:
"I want a tool to get stronger,
to make a name for myself"...
theater_main_quest_01_05_07_006: Every last one of 'em says the same thing.
theater_main_quest_01_05_07_007: That's wrong. That's not what weapons are for.
theater_main_quest_01_05_07_008:

theater_main_quest_01_05_07_009:
No matter what kind of crisis the wielder

theater_main_quest_01_05_07_010:
That's why I hate magic swords.

theater_main_quest_01_05_07_011:

theater_main_quest_01_05_07_012: So I don't forge magic swords.

Ushiwakamaru—no wait, it's a Minotaur knife,

No no no no no,

theater_main_quest_01_05_07_023:
We've only known each other a few days, so

theater_main_quest_01_05_07_024:

Now, our final briefing. Past there

Monsters from the middle floors on attack

Mr. Welf is the vanguard, Mr. Bell takes

However, with a supporter in the rear guard,

Mr. Bell!

theater_main_quest_01_05_08_011:
Sorry, sorry!
But doesn't this get you excited?
theater_main_quest_01_05_08_012:
All of us joining forces

theater_main_quest_01_05_08_013:
Pfft, hahahaha! Yeah, I get it!
You're not a man if this doesn't get

theater_main_quest_01_05_08_014:
Lili can't quite agree...!

theater_main_quest_01_05_08_015:
(It's okay. I'm not alone. They aren't in

Anyway... just because you're Level 2

The most important thing is to come back safe.

theater_main_quest_01_06_01_014:
Mikoto, don't push too hard just because

Well then, we're off,

theater_main_quest_01_06_01_024:

theater_main_quest_01_06_01_029:
Yeah.
I'm sure it's just a coincidence, but...
theater_main_quest_01_06_01_044:
...Well, for our first fight

theater_main_quest_01_06_01_045:
Yeah!

theater_main_quest_01_06_01_049:
If we get surrounded by monsters

About that "Little Rookie"...

theater_main_quest_01_06_02_004:

The gods' Falna isn't so generous it'd let

theater_main_quest_01_08_03_002:
I understand the circumstances.
There's no need to worry about it any longer.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_003:
...Y-you forgive me?
You don't think I'm lying...?
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_004:
Mr. Cranel... Humility may be a virtue,
but stop belittling yourself.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_005: It's a bad habit of yours.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_007:
...Oh, um, this is late, but thank you for
going out of your way to come rescue us.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_009:
Don't mention it.
I was planning to come here before long anyway.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_011:
Every now and then, Mama Mia gives me
time off to lay flowers for them.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_013:
The graves of my comrades from
the Familia I once belonged to.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_014:
A rival Familia trapped us in the Dungeon.
Everyone but me was killed.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_016: Mr. Cranel, will you hear me out?
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_021:
Ambushes, surprise attacks, traps—to avenge
my friends, I stopped at nothing, driven
by rage...
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_022: And then I ran out of strength.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_023:
After taking revenge on every one of them,
alone in a dark back alley.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_024:
A fitting end for someone who'd done
such foolish things. But...
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_026:
And that's how you ended up
at The Benevolent Mistress...?
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_027:
Yes.
Mama Mia took me in, knowing everything.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_028:
...I'm sorry for making you listen
to such an ugly story.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_030:
In short, I'm a shameless,
tyrannical elf—
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_031:
—one who would betray even
your trust, Mr. Cranel.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_038:
Ah... S-sorry.
That was cheeky of me...
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_041: You are a human worthy of respect.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_045: Whoa, whoa, you're in a mood, Mord.
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_046:
Shut up! What kinda trick did that brat use
to get down here...? Getting all cocky!
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_049: This ain't just my problem, y'know!
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_050:
Some cocky rookie ranks up and comes
straight down to the middle floors!
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_051:
Those of us who've been around for years
must look like a bunch of clowns!
theater_main_quest_01_08_03_054:
Someone's gotta teach him...
All we gotta do is lure him out alone.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_003: You peeped on AIS, of all people?!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_004:
You bastard, doing something
even I can't pull off!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_005: Oh, pipe down. That's over and done with.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_006:
It was settled that Lord Hermes is
to blame for everything.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_008:
L-lemme go, you stupid Amazons!
And why the hell is he even HERE?!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_011: You're leaving soon too, right, Ais...?
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_012:
Yes... I was put in the party leaving first.
You're going with the second group, right?
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_016:
Honestly, that Bell...
If he wants to peek, he should come
when it's just me...!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_024:
"Little Rookie." We've got your goddess.
If you want her back safe, come alone to the
lone crystal due east of the Central Tree.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_025:
Hey, do you think you can get away with this?!
I'm a goddess, y'know! Why, you...!!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_030: I ain't so blasphemous as to hurt a god.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_031: Then... your business is with me.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_032:
Relax, I won't let these guys lay a finger on you.
This is gonna be one-on-one... a duel.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_034:
That's right, simple, ain't it?
The winner gets to order the loser around.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_035: If I win, I'm stripping you of all your gear.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_036: If I win, give me back the goddess.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_037:
Sure, fine by me. But don't get the wrong idea,
you little punk. This is a show where I
torture you to death!!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_042:
Awesome, you really can't see him!
Get him, Mord!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_046: Whoa there... Too early for beddy-bye!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_047: Go on, get back in there!
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_049: Ain't you the promising rookie, huh?
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_054:
Honestly, this is in poor taste.
Do you have some grudge against Bell Cranel?
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_055: Hmm, I'd say it's more my own kind of love?
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_056:
Bell knows too little about the ugly side
of people.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_057:
Poor taste or not, I wanted him to learn it.
That side of people...
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_058: Well, I won't deny there's some fun in it too.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_059: And if his fangs break here?
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_060:
Heh heh... Then I guess he wasn't
the right material.
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_061:
Oh my... Looks like they've noticed too.
Honestly... every one of these kids is dazzling...
theater_main_quest_01_08_04_064: Bell should be just past there!
theater_main_quest_01_08_05_002: Ahh, sounds like they're having fun~!
theater_main_quest_01_08_05_003: Dammit, I wanna go watch too...
theater_main_quest_01_08_05_015:
I used a Chienthrope's sense of smell.
It's all thanks to that perfume you
wasted money on, Lady Hestia.
theater_main_quest_01_08_05_016:
Burn to ashes, heretical arts!
Will-o'-Wisp!
theater_main_quest_01_08_05_024: Don't flinch, we've got the numbers!
theater_main_quest_01_08_05_027: Damn it, I can't get to Bell...!
theater_main_quest_01_09_01_003: The Dungeon hates us, you see.
theater_main_quest_01_09_01_004: Us gods, for locking it up down here.
theater_main_quest_01_09_01_005:
Ouranos... What happened to your prayers?
Nobody told me about this.
theater_main_quest_01_09_01_010: Ah... So it IS the floor boss.
theater_main_quest_01_09_01_014: W-we have to help them, quick!
theater_main_quest_01_09_01_017:
Do you really intend to go help them?
With this party?
theater_main_quest_01_09_01_025: Ms. Chigusa, please look after the goddess.
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_007:
—Damn it...
Why... how did it come to this—
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_011:
You'll get in Mr. Bell's way,
so Lili's hauling you off!
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_013:
Be grateful, will you?
To our hopelessly good-natured leader!
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_016: What in the hell... is that...?
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_018: Gather every weapon and adventurer you can!
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_019: We're taking down the floor boss!
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_020:
Are you crazy, Andromeda?!
That's no ordinary floor boss—
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_022:
For all intents and purposes,
we can't escape this floor.
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_024:
Unless we defeat that thing,
we won't be getting out of here.
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_027:
Listen up, you lot!
We're taking on that monster!
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_030:
Anyone who turns tail won't ever
be allowed in this town again!
theater_main_quest_01_09_02_049: (...As I thought, this is no normal floor boss.)
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_001:
(Lion! Reinforcements. The town's mages
are beginning their chants now.)
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_003:
(Understood. You and I will split
the enemy's attention between us.)
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_007:
Andromeda's gonna be the decoy.
Start chanting, no worries!
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_013:
Buy some time!
Once the chants are done—
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_021:
We've got weapons to spare!
If yours breaks, swap it out quick!
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_022:
We're a ragtag bunch to begin with!
Forget teamwork!
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_023: Just don't get in each other's way!
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_037: We're hitting it with something huge!
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_057: Mr. Cranel, take care of the monsters around us.
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_060: We can't just let it trample us.
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_061:
If we buy time, any mages still able to move
can fire their magic again.
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_062:
And if that fails... we'll beat it again!
As many times as it takes!
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_067: Please gather every piece of gear you can!
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_068: You heard her! Head back to town, and thanks!
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_071: She ran off after that explosion.
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_072: She's probably with Ouka and the others.
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_078: (I must do my part as well.)
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_079:
Even if we aim for its core—its magic stone—
it's too tough. At this rate, sooner or later—
theater_main_quest_01_09_03_080: Even so, as long as there's hope...
